summary.coverage_gaps: Frozen brief: 432 active ranked companies, 982 mapped company-city pairs, 14 cities and 169 open roles. Broad city-led searches are complete as a first-pass layer (14/14), but employer-by-employer checks are not complete; no row-level completion ledger exists for the 432 companies or 982 pairs. Three of 169 pre-existing active roles with November deadlines were reviewed; the remaining role-status/deadline refresh is outstanding. Hong Kong/Singapore deep scan remains incomplete. Do not call this a completed weekly sweep. Selective named-employer pulse does not close the 432-company or 982 company-city-pair audit. Full per-role refresh and remaining Hong Kong/Singapore deep scan are still required. Programme discovery remains targeted rather than complete across the 23 University Search cities. SJTU Low Carbon Energy 2027 cycle and precise campus coordinates remain to verify.

summary.results_summary: Added Modo Energy Market Analyst, Modeling (CAISO/SPP), IMC Commodities Analyst – China and Commodities Trader – China (Sydney), Trafigura Crude Trader (Geneva), and enfinium Energy Analyst (London). Added enfinium to Company Registry at provisional rank 433; no street office was inferred. Moved Chevron Singapore Trading Analyst to Expired Roles after deadline plus employer-page 404. Updated UNIGE MSc in Commodity Trading with mandatory GRE/GMAT, GMAT 550 floor, 2027 application window and required Swiss industry traineeship. Several other leads remain pending or excluded with reasons in city-led-discovery.md. Selective priority employer pulse refreshed S&P Global Singapore Commodity Associate deadline (Nov 13) and professional-Mandarin requirement; candidate fit reduced to 2/10 and duplicate req row consolidated. Jane Street Hong Kong Quantitative Trader was rechecked and role fit reduced 9.8→8.8 because the posting does not state commodities coverage. Added Citadel Commodities Analyst expression-of-interest route, explicitly not a live vacancy. Current Glencore, Mercuria, Vitol, Norlys, SPC, Aurora, Axpo and Senoko postings were rechecked; no new job rows were warranted in this subset. Refreshed three existing 2027 programme records: CityUHK MSc Energy and Environment corrected to 31 May 2027 final deadline (rolling); Bayes MSc Energy, Trade and Finance confirmed September 2027 and rolling applications; UNIGE Commodity Trading eligibility updated with maximum-three-years professional experience (Ross CV shows two years as of the check). Added SJTU China-UK Low Carbon College Low Carbon Energy as a Research Inbox lead only because its international admissions page still shows 2026 dates and the exact campus map point is not yet verified.
